map.代谢当量（MET）是运动强度单位，1 MET 约等于安静坐位耗氧 3.5 ml/: The metabolic equivalent (MET) is an exercise intensity unit where 1 MET is about 3.5 ml/(kg·min) of oxygen consumption at rest while seated. Higher means more effort: walking is about 2-3 METs, jogging about 7-8 METs and competitive sport above 10 METs.
map.以运动负荷试验得出的缺血阈心率与无氧阈为基础，设定靶心率区与 RPE 主观疲劳度: Base target zones on the ischaemic threshold heart rate and anaerobic threshold from an exercise test, with target heart rate zones and RPE subjective fatigue; follow warm-up, aerobic and cool-down, and slow down and seek care immediately for chest pain, marked breathlessness or dizziness.
map.将代谢当量 METs 换算为日常活动强度、运动项目与摄氧量 VO2，帮助医师制定: Convert metabolic equivalents (METs) into daily activity intensity, exercise items and oxygen uptake VO2, helping physicians write cardiac rehabilitation prescriptions and safe intensity ranges.
map.康复分期与禁忌：依据 LVEF、运动试验结果设定靶心率与上限，识别胸闷/气促等警: Rehabilitation staging and contraindications: set target heart rate and ceilings from LVEF and exercise test results, identify warning signs such as chest tightness or breathlessness, and ensure safe progression.
map.心梗后、PCI/搭桥术后、稳定心衰、心脏移植及部分瓣膜术后等稳定期患者。急性期、: Stable-phase patients after myocardial infarction, PCI or bypass, stable heart failure, heart transplant and some valve surgeries. Contraindications include the acute phase, uncontrolled arrhythmia and severe aortic stenosis; start only after a rehab physician assesses.
